in_latin.name: Coralyn
in_latin.meaning: coralium, a coral, sea, abundance of life, a beautiful and precious gem
in_latin.long_meaning: Coralyn, a name of Latin origin, derived from the Greek word κερληνε, meaning coral, sea, and abundance of life. In ancient times, coral was a symbol of love, beauty, and purity. The name Coralyn is a combination of the Latin words coralium and lyn, meaning beauty, to convey the idea of a beautiful and precious gem. The name has been used in various forms throughout history, including Corallina, Coralina, and Coralyne.
